info.title: sharpapng command line tool
info.description: Command line tool for building and inspecting animated PNGs. Creates an APNG from a sequence of PNG, JPEG, GIF or BMP images, converts GIF to APNG and JPEG or BMP to PNG, makes thumbnails, lists a file's frames and delays, and splits an animation back into composited still frames.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: sharpapng - build and inspect animated PNGs

options.name: --output

Where to write the APNG. Required.
Where to write the APNG. Defaults to the input name.
Where to write the PNG. Defaults to <input>.thumb.png.

options.name: --poster
options.description:
A still shown only by viewers without APNG support,
kept out of the animation. Must match the canvas.

options.name: --delay
options.description: Milliseconds per frame. Default 100.

options.name: --loop
options.description:
Play count; 0 loops forever. Default 0.
Override the play count.

options.name: --16-bit
options.description: Store 16 bits per channel instead of 8.

options.name: --no-optimize
options.description: Store every frame whole instead of just what changed.

options.name: --fast
options.description: Compress quickly rather than tightly.

options.name: --smallest
options.description: Compress as tightly as zlib allows.

options.name: --transparent
options.description: Erase a colour: #RRGGBB, #RGB, or 'background' to use

options.name: --tolerance
options.description: How far a channel may differ and still be erased. Default 0.

options.name: --literal-delays
options.description: Copy the stated delays instead of clamping very short

options.name: --size
options.description: Bound on the longer side, preserving aspect. Default 128.

options.name: --width
options.description: Exact width, used with --height.

options.name: --height
options.description: Exact height, used with --width.

options.name: --filter
options.description: box (default), triangle or lanczos3.
